options.text: When the substrate inhibits the enzyme at the start of a pathway
When the final product of a metabolic pathway inhibits an enzyme earlier in the pathway
When an enzyme stops working after producing one product
When two enzymes compete for the same substrate

questions.explanation: End-product inhibition (feedback inhibition) occurs when the final product of a metabolic pathway acts as an inhibitor of an enzyme earlier in the pathway, preventing overproduction and helping to regulate metabolism.
